en: Vintage, lightly colorized postcard showing a stone gate tower on the left leading into a road that curves past trees toward a dramatic cityscape built on cliffs. The skyline features church spires and historic buildings overlooking a deep valley. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as Luxembourg and specifically the Porte de Trèves, with publisher details in small type.
